descriptions.description: Flors d´uns 3 mm; llegum cordiforme-triangular, de 6-9 x 4-6 mm; 4-7parells de folíols; pèls medifixos, aplicats. Herba prostrada o ascendent, grisenca; folíols oblongs, mucronats; estípules lanceolato-acuminades, lliures; glomèruls esferoïdals, densos, de 6-12 flors; calze de 2,5-3 mm, amb les dents poc més curtes que el tub; estendard d´uns 3 mm; llegum..deprimit, solcat al dors, densament pilós, patent o reflex. Th. rept., 5-20 cm. IV-V.

descriptions.description: Biserrula is a genus of flowering plants in the family Fabaceae, found in Portugal (including Madeira and Selvagens), the Canary Islands, all the Mediterranean countries, the Arabian peninsula, and in east Africa as far south as Tanzania. Biserrula pelecinus, generally called just "biserrula", is under domestication in Australia as a forage legume.
Currently accepted species include: Biserrula epiglottis (L.) Coulot, Rabaute & J.-M.Tison Biserrula pelecinus L.
